checks.description: All checks resolved this turn, in the order the turn's checks were used, batched into a single emission (emit-event dedupes by topic per turn, so one event must carry every check). The d20, the DC and the total are not reported: the system takes the dice in order and calculates them.

action.description: Short description of the attempted risky action, as it appears in the narrative.

attribute.description: Character attribute the modifier was derived from, if any.

modifier.description: Attribute modifier of the action, derived from the numeric attribute on the player character's sheet.

difficulty.description: Difficulty chosen from the fiction: easy (DC 8), normal (DC 12), hard (DC 16), extreme (DC 20).

outcome.description: The outcome that this turn's check table gives for the chosen difficulty and modifier. It is checked against the dice.
